subject: Pre-audit: Subprocessor QA pack and export proof for CoxHealth
messages:
From: Erin Landry <erin.landry@coxhealth.org>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: security@coxhealth.org, audits@coxhealth.org
Date: 2027-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pre-audit: subprocessor QA needs

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking this on quickly. CoxHealth has a scheduled vendor assurance review in three weeks and our pubic health compliance team needs a compact "subprocessor QA pack" from Redwood ahead of the on-site. At minimum we need: a current subprocessor inventory with onboarding/termination dates, a short SOC 2 Type II summary or attestation, a redacted sample of an export (proof of data export mechanics), and a short excerpt from your DPIA or processing map showing data flows for patient-identifiable attributes.

Can you please confirm what you can provide by next Friday 10/08? If you have a brief checklist or a DPA addendum template we can pre-load into our procurement portal, that would also speed things up.

Thanks,
Erin
Erin Landry
Vendor Assurance Lead | CoxHealth
attachments: none in original

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Erin Landry <erin.landry@coxhealth.org>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-audit: subprocessor QA needs

Hi Erin —

Appreciate the heads up. We can assemble a compact pack by 2027-10-08. High level plan:
- Subprocessor inventory (CSV) with onboarding / termination columns — we will include last processed date.
- SOC 2 Type II condensed summary and a pointer to the full report (redacted summary pdf).
- Redacted export sample (we can provide a single user-level export with PII tokenized/redacted plus a short explainer of the export steps).
- Processing map excerpt (Art.30-style ledger snippet) showing flows for the PHI attributes you called out.
- DPA addendum template for signature.

Question for clarity: do you need raw access logs or just a sampled, redacted trace that demonstrates the export path? Our standard response is a redacted trace — we avoid sharing raw logs unless under a mutual NDA and audit-specific controls.

Looping in Marissa and Grace to pull the artifacts; Karthik, can you prepare the redacted export sample and point to the SOC2 summary location?

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Manager, Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-audit: subprocessor QA needs — artifacts ready?

Quick update:
- Subprocessor inventory: attached CSV (redwood-subprocessor-inventory-2027Q3.csv). Columns include: processor_name, country, contract_start, contract_end, data_categories, subprocessed_operations.
- SOC 2: we are attaching a 2-page summary (soc2-type2-summary-2026.pdf) and a secure link to the full report for on-site reviewers only.
- Export sample: created a redacted export file (export-sample-redacted-2027-09.txt). This shows the API call, the export manifest, and a tokenized payload; no raw PII.
- DPIA/processing map excerpt: there is a short extract in the Drive folder; I added a README that maps the fields to CoxHealth's requested attributes.
- DPA addendum: I uploaded a working template (dpa-addendum-template.docx). We typically request that procurement review and sign the addendum; legal can do a one-page SLA exception if you need.

I should note: full raw logs are not something we provide by default. For audit-only access we can offer time-limited read-only access to a redacted audit view under an auxiliary agreement (we'll need SOC2/NDA and a signed addendum).

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG-example
DocuSign placeholder (for your convenience): https://docusign.com/COX-2027-014/pack

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-subprocessor-inventory-2027Q3.csv; soc2-type2-summary-2026.pdf; export-sample-redacted-2027-09.txt; dpa-addendum-template.docx

From: Erin Landry <erin.landry@coxhealth.org>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: security@coxhealth.org, audits@coxhealth.org
Date: 2027-10-05T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-audit: subprocessor QA needs — clarifications

Thanks Karthik, Priyom. This is helpful. A couple clarifications before your final pack:
1) For the subprocessor inventory, can you add the jurisdiction column and the latest data transfer mechanism (SCCs / adequacy / none)?
2) For the export redacted sample — we need one example that covers both skyburst and manual exports (API vs console). If console exports are not possible in a redacted form, the API trace will suffice; please just note the difference in the README.
3) The DPIA excerpt: we only need the section that maps the lawful basis and technical measures for processing patient identifiers — a 1-page excerpt is fine.

If you can deliver the updated CSV + the redacted API + a short cover note about access controls by EOD 10/08, that will let us triage before the on-site. For anything that requires time-limited audit access, please flag it clearly so procurement can draft the auxiliary agreement.

Best,
Erin

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Erin Landry <erin.landry@coxhealth.org>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-08T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-audit: Subprocessor QA pack and export proof for CoxHealth — delivery

Erin —

Attached is the compact QA pack per your ask. Deliverables (attached / linked):
- redwood-subprocessor-inventory-2027Q3.csv (updated with jurisdiction and transfer mechanism column)
- soc2-type2-summary-2026.pdf (attached)
- export-sample-redacted-2027-09.txt (API example) 
- README_Delivery.txt (short cover note describing export mechanics, console limitations, and what would require time-limited audit access)
- dpa-addendum-template.docx (editable template)

We are not providing raw access logs. If CoxHealth requires an audit-only read view, we can make that available under a short auxiliary agreement; please let us know and we will have procurement/legal draft a minimal addendum.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the API redacted export plus the README covers the console case for your reviewers. If you want us to prepare a one-page DPIA excerpt we can do that as a follow-up (estimate 1 business day).

Thanks all —
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Manager, Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-subprocessor-inventory-2027Q3.csv; soc2-type2-summary-2026.pdf; export-sample-redacted-2027-09.txt; dpa-addendum-template.docx
